subject: physics

hotspots.label: Cart
hotspots.description: The object whose motion carries kinetic energy — roll it and the bar fills.
hotspots.colorHint: Amber cart gliding on the track.
hotspots.function: Carries the motion whose kinetic energy is measured.

hotspots.label: Ramp & Track
hotspots.description: The ramp that releases the cart from height and the flat run where it glides with kinetic energy.
hotspots.colorHint: Warm wooden ramp sloping to the flat ribbon.
hotspots.function: Converts height into speed while the cart travels.

hotspots.label: Energy Bar
hotspots.description: The joule readout climbing with the cart's motion — the visible kinetic energy.
hotspots.colorHint: A vertical energy meter at the track edge.
hotspots.function: Displays the kinetic energy value in joules.

hotspots.label: Speed Slider
hotspots.description: Changes the cart's speed — the squared term that makes the bar jump four times when doubled.
hotspots.colorHint: A green track slider on a pedestal.
hotspots.function: Sets the speed input of the KE formula.

hotspots.label: Mass Slider
hotspots.description: Sets the cart's mass in kg — a linear effect, doubling it doubles the energy.
hotspots.colorHint: A smaller amber slider below the speed one.
hotspots.function: Sets the mass input of the KE formula.

visualStyleNotes: Warm off-white paper background, soft vignette. A wooden ramp leading to a flat track, an amber cart, a green energy bar, and two slider pedestals. Saturated color only on the bar and dots. Soft neutral light, no bloom, no emissive.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness, metallic=0. Ramp/track warm wood (roughness ~0.55). Cart amber smooth (0.4). Bar green translucent-light side (no emissive; luminance through texture only). Sliders warm-grey with colored knobs.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: kinetic energy building on a ramp-track, with squared-speed and mass effects.

GEOMETRY: a ramp (left, rising to y≈1.1) flowing into a flat track to +x; amber cart at the ramp top start; a slim vertical energy bar (1.2,0.9,0) and two slider pedestals (-1.3,0.6,0.2) & (-1.3,0.35,0.2).

INTERACTION: sliders set mass (1-8 kg) and speed (1-4 m/s); the bar fills to KE = ½mv² instantly; Release sends the cart down the ramp animating potential→kinetic.

LAYERS: ramp+track; cart; bar; sliders.

NAMED NODES: Ramp, TrackRibbon, Cart, EnergyBar, SpeedSlider, MassSlider, ValueBadge. 6-9k tris.
